app.name: BuildForU
app.tagline: Construction operations, with a cleaner view.

login.title: Manage field operations without the noise.
login.subtitle: Sign in to access schedules, tasks, team communication and project visibility for your role.
login.helper: Use a demo account to preview the current frontend experience.
login.mockPassword: Any password works in this prototype.
login.accessNote: Secure access for BuildForU office and field teams.
login.featureI18n: Multilingual UI powered by mock data

sidebar.crewRhythmSubtitle: Site updates are syncing smoothly today.

dashboard.adminHeroBody: Today's operation board surfaces workforce coverage, task pressure, live schedules and delivery health in one streamlined view.
dashboard.calendarSubtitle: Company-wide task coverage for the current month.
dashboard.projectSubtitle: Delivery pulse across your flagship projects.
dashboard.chatSubtitle: Coordinate quickly with workers and supervisors.
dashboard.employeeHeroBody: Your schedule is aligned for the week. The next site checkpoint is already pinned and your boss chat stays a tap away.
dashboard.employeeCalendarSubtitle: See your assigned work blocks and site visits for the current month.
dashboard.employeeEmptyTasks: No assignments are waiting right now.
dashboard.quickPulseSubtitle: A concise read on your workload and schedule quality.
dashboard.scheduleConfidenceDetail: No conflicts detected in your next five shifts.
dashboard.siteRhythmDetail: Material delivery and inspection timing are both on track.

calendar.title: Schedule calendar

calendar.upcomingTimelineSubtitle: A quick scroll of the next scheduled activities.

calendar.emptyMonth: No scheduled items for this month.
calendar.formSubtitle: Create a mock assignment directly from the calendar view.
calendar.emptyWorker: Add a worker to assign tasks

tasks.title: Task management
tasks.subtitle: Track assignments, statuses and delivery pace.
tasks.filterHint: Filter view is mocked on the frontend and ready for backend integration later.

chat.title: Team chat
chat.subtitle: Stay aligned with the office and crews in real time.
chat.emptySubtitle: Choose a thread to review updates and send new messages.

messages.m-1: Morning Alex, please prioritize the slab inspection today.
messages.m-2: On it. I will upload notes after the walkthrough.
messages.m-3: Can you confirm the cabling team arrival for Skyline?
messages.m-4: Confirmed. We start at 09:00 and should finish the east wing by noon.
messages.m-5: Pressure test is scheduled for 14:30. Awaiting valve delivery.

workers.subtitle: Monitor crew performance, availability and next shifts.

workers.averagePerformanceDetail: Based on current mock completion rates.

attendance.detailsDescription: View recorded attendance status, timestamps and optional location coordinates.
